## Background

I studied Computer Science at the University of Saskatchewan and have worked in the Canadian technology sector for several years. My experience has included software development, Research in data-related projects, and working with different technologies across startups and other organizations.

## Why Data Science?

I decided to pursue a Master of Data Science at UBC because I want to build stronger skills in statistics, data analysis, and machine learning. I am especially interested in applying data science to practical problems and eventually working on projects that can have a meaningful impact.

## Outside of Data Science

Outside of school and technology, I enjoy classical dance, music, performing, learning new choreography, and exploring creative projects. I also love spending time outdoors, whether it’s hiking, exploring new places, or simply enjoying nature. I enjoy spending time with my community and finding ways to bring together my technical, creative, and personal interests.
